profile.headline: Lead Frontend Software Engineer @ Farran Media
profile.summary: I'm passionate about UI/UX web design and game development. I'm driven by the creative freedom that computer programming offers.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Designed a website that formats REST API JSON data for IoT devices into an organized UI used for building device templates (Full-stack development, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB). 
Created and containerized a web application to simulate the interaction of our web platform with outside services (Full-stack development, REST API, Node.js, Express.js, Docker, Dapr, Kubernetes).
Helped set up gateway devices to communicate with the Microsoft Azure Cloud.
Worked closely with the development team to resolve bugs and UI/UE issues on the main web platform.
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Microsoft Azure · Software Project Management · Web Development · Full-Stack Development · Cloud Applications

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I worked as an assistant within the machine shop. I organized their newly implemented online database that kept track of the company's shipping/receiving details, equipment inspection/calibration, and many other details concerning internal and external operations.  I made the database more informative and simpler to navigate, in order to better represent the company's purpose and their needs going forward.

positions.title: Operator
positions.description: Worked as part of a team maintaining assembly lines that produce airbag inflators. Involved inspecting parts for critical failures, repairing robots after faults, preparing the assembly line to run as efficiently as possible, material handling and managing storage of partially completed and completed parts.

positions.title: Grader/Tutor
positions.description: Graded student homework and tests as well as offered tutoring when students needed guidance. Helped with all subjects; assignment difficulty ranged up to high school level.

honors.title: Summa Cum Laude with Highest Honors
honors.description: Graduated Summa Cum Laude with Highest Honors and was awarded a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.
honors.issuer: Issued by Arizona State University · May 2024
